{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the [[in-universe]] trash compactor|[[Wookieepedia]]'s [[Forum:Trash compactor|Trash compactor forum]]}}
[[File:ItsWorse-TCGCoreSet.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, and Chewbacca stuck in the Death Star garbage masher.]]
{{Quote|One thing's for sure. We're all gonna be a lot thinner!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''garbage compactor''' (or '''trash compactor''') was a metal chamber used to store and compress refuse. The walls would come together and compress and crush the garbage. The doors to the compactors were usually [[Magnetic seal/Legends|magsealed]].

The garbage compactor that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] fell into aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]], [[Garbage Compactor 3263827]], was under the category of recyclable waste.

They were attacked by a [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]], which were known to live in garbage compactors. Luke was almost killed when the dianoga took him underwater.

Garbage compactors could also be small in scale, and fit into the interior chassis of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
